name: No Selling Price Set at All
query:
SELECT 
    i.name AS item_code,
    i.item_name,
    ip.price_list_rate
FROM `tabItem` i
LEFT JOIN `tabItem Price` ip
    ON ip.item_code = i.name
    AND ip.selling = 1
WHERE 
    i.item_group = "Drug" and i.disabled = 0 and
    ip.price_list_rate IS NULL
    OR ip.price_list_rate = 0
ORDER BY i.name;
report_name: No Selling Price Set at All
